### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_site` | Read get site in the tenant-authorized SharePoint site. Use site-id from the site URL or discovery. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_drives` | Read list drives in the tenant-authorized SharePoint site. Use site-id from the site URL or discovery. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_lists` | Read list lists in the tenant-authorized SharePoint site. Use site-id from the site URL or discovery. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_list` | Read get list in the tenant-authorized SharePoint site. Use site-id from the site URL or discovery. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_items` | Read list items in the tenant-authorized SharePoint site. Use site-id from the site URL or discovery. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_item` | Read get item in the tenant-authorized SharePoint site. Use site-id from the site URL or discovery. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_columns` | Read list columns in the tenant-authorized SharePoint site. Use site-id from the site URL or discovery. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_content_types` | Read list content types in the tenant-authorized SharePoint site. Use site-id from the site URL or discovery. | yes | no | auto |
